newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks take breather after heady gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks take breather after heady gains.

text.p: MADRID, July 4 (Reuter) 0815 GMT - Madrid stocks opened lower on Friday amid profit-taking after three sessions in which the indices broke historic highs, dealers said.

Lower prices on other European bourses and in the bond market provided the backdrop for this. But trade was expected to be relatively dull amid a U.S. public holiday and a lack of fresh domestic market-moving factors.

Dealers saw the bourse rebounding from these levels. * General index down 1.78 points, 0.28 percent, 623.52 * Ibex down 14.21 points, 0.2 percent, to 7,260.20 * Repsol still firm, adds 10 pesetas to 6,560, continuing to catch up with gains in the rest of the market, dealers said.

"We're expecting a quiet day, without the U.S. for a reference point, and with a bit of profit-taking after the run we've had. But this won't last long and we'll see the indices pick up again," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
Repsol, at a price-earnings ratio (PE) of 14.4 times, according to the trader, should see further upside. The rest of the market is at an average PE of around 20, he said.
